subject: Front caliper: spring, dust caps, guide pins and carrier bolts, on a 2010 BMW 328i (E90) with the 3.0L inline-6, shown so a home mechanic can see what the step is about. Step: "Remove the anti-rattle spring".

mustShow.text: HERO: A floating disc-brake caliper straddling the rotor, seen from the outboard side with the wheel removed.

Two guide pins with hex-socket heads that hold the caliper to the carrier; they unthread to free the caliper. Do NOT depict where its fasteners sit: keep it a plain generic shape.
